task_description: Write a method in Dafny to find the sum of even numbers at even positions of an integer array.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method SumEvenNumbersAtEvenPositions(arr: array<int>) returns (sum: int)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The output sum is equal to the sum of all even numbers located at even indices (0-based) in the input array
    - All elements added to the sum are even
    - Only elements at even positions in the array are considered in the sum
